name: Franco Cortese
features: olive skin, dark hair receding, dark eyes, lean lined face, slight build, wry patient expression
bio: Cortese entered 156 races between 1927 and 1958 and finished the Mille Miglia fourteen times, more than anyone. In May 1947 he drove the very first car to carry the Ferrari name, the 125 S, and won with it at Rome a fortnight later — the first victory in the history of the marque.
